question: List all product names with their category.
Total quantity purchased per product name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pu.quantity) FROM purchases pu JOIN products p ON p.id=pu.product_id GROUP BY p.id

question: Which products have never been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s WHERE s.product_id=p.id)

question: What is the best selling product by quantity?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(s.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Current stock of each product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(b.bought,0)-COALESCE(s.sold,0) AS stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id

question: Which product has the most stock left?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(b.bought,0)-COALESCE(s.sold,0) AS stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id ORDER BY stock DESC LIMIT 1
